hook: Dhoni's gone. Chennai's squad has 4 of 7 roles at playoff level. Only RCB has more.
lines: We graded every squad on seven roles.
Roles where playoff sides beat the rest, like middle-overs spin: 15 seasons of 19.
Samson and Gaikwad now open at playoff level.
Delhi are 1 of 7, with 39.5 crore to spend.
And 6 of 10 squads are behind at five to seven.
